title: Hind Paw Withdrawal Test for Rodents
author: Eva Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x67frhn
materials: - Must clean equipment with sporeklenz before entering the animal room - All restrainers need to be exclusively used in same room. If restrainer has been in another animal room, it CANNOT be used! - The True Tail Temp cannot be used for the paw test. It must be disabled. Press 6000E on keypad of CPU. It is on by default. - Test Head needs to be removed from Tail Flick machine and placed under heated glass. - Never remove cable from test head or back of tail flick machine when it is on. Failure to pay attention may damage electrical circuits in machine.

steps.title: Acclimate mice to the machine
steps.instruction: Acclimate each animal with three 15-minute sessions. Turn on the heat to medium (approximately 32°C) 10 minutes before animals enter the box.

steps.title: Configure machine settings
steps.instruction: Enter the following keyboard commands to set the machine parameters:

substeps.instruction: Set Active Intensity to 25%: #3 (e.g., 3050E for 50%, adjust to 25%)
Set Idle Intensity to 1%: #4 (e.g., 4050E for 50%, adjust to 1%)
Set Cutoff timer to 35 seconds: #5 (e.g., 5025E for 25s, adjust to 35s)
Set Time of day (24 hr format, 5 digit sequence): #7 (e.g., 00100E for 1am)

steps.title: Prepare animals for testing
steps.instruction: Place one mouse in each of the 6 cubes and allow them to settle for 15 minutes until calm.

steps.title: Position test head and beam
steps.instruction: Position the Test Head under the mouse's paw and use the minimum amount of idle intensity necessary to focus the beam properly to avoid negative conditioning.

steps.title: Perform paw withdrawal test
steps.instruction: Initiate and terminate the test using the footswitch or the red button.

substeps.instruction: Press the footswitch or red button to start the test.
Press the red button or footswitch immediately when the mouse moves its paw to stop the test.

steps.title: Record test data
steps.instruction: Collect the data manually or via printer after the test ends.

substeps.instruction: Note the three flashing numbers: P (Finish temp), B (Start temp), and Blank (elapsed time).

steps.title: Complete measurement series
steps.instruction: Collect a total of 6 measurements per animal, ensuring mice remain totally calm.

substeps.instruction: Alternate between left and right feet.
Wait approximately 10 minutes between each test.
